patch.value: Release workflow publishes npm before advancing protected main (GH006 desync)

Daily Release published pm-context@2026.8.9 to npm and then its direct HEAD:main push was rejected by protected-branch policy (GH006), leaving npm at 2026.8.9 while git main stays at 2026.8.7 with no tag. Replace the direct push with a release-branch pull-request transaction that merges validated metadata before any irreversible npm publication, mirroring pm-changelog's release.yml.

Workflow requests pull-requests:write and never directly pushes HEAD:main; release metadata is pushed to a deterministic branch and merged via a PR before npm publish; merged main is verified at the intended npm version; tag is created on the merged commit only after publish succeeds; retry paths reuse an existing PR/version and skip already-published npm versions; workflow syntax and the full release gate pass.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Diagnosis: .github/workflows/release.yml ran 'Publish npm package' (line ~149) BEFORE 'Push release tag and main' (git push origin HEAD:main). On 2026-08-09 ~04:40 the daily release published pm-context@2026.8.9 to npm, then the direct HEAD:main push was rejected by protected-branch policy (GH006), leaving npm at 2026.8.9 while git main stayed at 2026.8.7 with no v2026.08.09 tag. Because npm is immutable, any push failure permanently desyncs npm from git.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Fix (ported from pm-changelog release.yml / pmc-84ow): added pull-requests:write; added base_sha output to 'Decide release'; inserted 'Merge release metadata through protected PR' (pushes release/<ver>, opens/reuses a PR, merges via API with merge_method=rebase and sha=<release_commit> pinned) and 'Verify merged release' (refetches origin/main, asserts merged SHA + package version, re-runs release:check, diffs package.json package-lock.json manifest.json index.ts dist CHANGELOG.md); replaced 'Push release tag and main' with a tag-only 'Push release tag'. Invariant now enforced: git main contains the release commit BEFORE npm publish runs.
